title: Resident CUDA, streamed host banks, streamed disk banks and asynchronous streamed tiles give the same spectral fields, objective and gradient on one scatterer

fixture.region: 3D, 2.4 x 1.6 x 1.6 um, uniform mesh 0.1 um (24 x 16 x 16 cells), 3 CPML cells on every face, Yee material sampling, staircase interfaces, 40 steps at the CFL time step (1.9066e-16 s)
fixture.structure: smooth sphere of radius 0.3 um, sigmoid transition width 0.08 um, at the origin: permittivity 4 in air (scalar or diagonal Yee-sampled); Drude variant: epsilon_inf 2 inside, one Drude pole (omega0 = 0, gamma = 1e14 rad/s) of strength s_hat * 4e30 (rad/s)^2 with s_hat the sphere mask; stored-face variant: PMC y faces, symmetric z_min, PEC z_max with the scalar sphere and the stored upper rows; tensor variant: the admissible SPD node-tensor field of tests/test_anisotropy_walls.py (seed 29), FP32, point observations only
fixture.source: Ez point source at (-0.7, 0, 0) um, standard Gaussian pulse, wavelength 0.8 um, power FWHM 1.5 fs, envelope centre 2 fs, amplitude 100

observations.history: two point probes Ez (0.7, 0, 0) and Hy (0.5, 0.2, 0) as the full time history, then DifferentiableResult.spectrum at 3e14 Hz
observations.online: the same two probes accumulated as an online DFT at 3e14 Hz (StreamedSimulation.spectrum, DifferentiableSimulation.spectrum)
observations.plane: one x-normal spectral plane at x = 0.7 um, 0.8 x 0.8 um, downsample 2, all six components at 3e14 Hz (DifferentiablePlaneSimulation, DispersivePlaneSimulation)

fixture.objective: sum over frequencies, samples and components of |F / dt|^2 where F is the spectral field and dt the time step, so that the objective and its gradients are dimensionless per-step amplitudes

paths.resident: DifferentiableSimulation / DispersiveSimulation / TensorDielectricSimulation with AdjointOptions(checkpoints=2) on a CUDA epsilon: the reference
paths.host_sync: StreamedAdjointOptions(device=cuda, slab_width=6, temporal_depth=4, checkpoints=2, state_storage=host, tile_transfers=sync)
paths.disk_sync: the same with state_storage=disk, a private scratch directory and disk_budget_bytes 256 MiB
paths.host_async: the same as host_sync with tile_transfers=async and tile_buffers=2

fixture.instances: precision {float32, float64} x material {scalar, diagonal, drude, pmc} x observation {history, online, plane} x path {host_sync, disk_sync, host_async}, minus pmc x plane (refused by the registry), plus float32 x tensor x online x the three paths: 96 streamed runs against 21 resident references
fixture.refusals: planes_pmc, streamed_dispersive_oneway, streamed_dispersive_planes_oneway and mode_network_streamed from torchfdtd/capabilities.py, built by example_project and constructed with StreamedAdjointOptions

reference_method: the resident CUDA discrete adjoint of the same scene (fused CUDA forward and transpose for real dielectric fields, Torch ADE and tensor transposes): a separate execution path over the same Yee discretization, not an analytic oracle; the agreement it establishes is that the streamed tiers reproduce the resident result

observables.name: max_abs_field_error
observables.definition: max |F_streamed - F_resident| / dt over frequencies, samples and components

observables.name: objective
observables.definition: sum |F / dt|^2 of the streamed run; objective_reference is the resident value

observables.name: max_abs_gradient_error
observables.definition: max |g_streamed - g_resident| for every differentiable input (epsilon, epsilon_inf and s_hat, or the node tensor)

acceptance.rule: torch.testing.assert_close(streamed, resident, rtol, atol) on the spectral amplitude per time step, on the objective and on every gradient, for every instance; the reference amplitude must exceed 1e-3 and every reference gradient 1e-6 so that the comparison is not vacuous
acceptance.refusals: each listed combination raises ValueError whose message starts with the registry rule's expected message before torchfdtd.streamed._Streamed.apply is reached
acceptance.source_of_limits: completion_gates.json proposed_thresholds discrete_dimensionless_fp32 (rtol 1e-4, atol 1e-6) and discrete_dimensionless_fp64 (rtol 1e-7, atol 1e-9): layer A, the same discretization on two execution paths

not_yet_covered: disk banks with asynchronous tiles (the async variant is measured on host banks only)
tensor material with spectral planes (the Project schema rejects tensor media with plane monitors, see the registry)

notes: Declared before the recorded run on branch g5-memory from main 73203d2. Prototype runs on the RTX 3060 at this commit showed gradient differences of order 1e-9 (float32) and 1e-18 (float64) against limits of 1e-6 and 1e-9, which is why the layer-A thresholds are used unchanged. The record is docs/validation/g5/G5-01.json.
